result.text:
Fixed: quoted cells such as `"Müller, Hans"` now import with the comma intact, and all 105 tests pass.

The cause was in `src/legacy/csvImport.ts`. It split every line with a plain `line.split(',')`, so a comma inside quotes created an extra cell and shifted the later columns. I added a small quote-aware splitter. It keeps commas inside double quotes and treats `""` as a literal quote. It's used for both the header and the data rows.

I added a test to `test/import.test.ts`. It parses a row with `"Müller, Hans"` and `"Hof ""A"", Top 3"`, and checks that name, street, zip, city and phone come out in the right columns.

Newlines inside quoted cells are still not supported, because the parser splits on lines first. Error line numbers from `/import` depend on that, so I left it alone. If the warehouse export can contain multi-line addresses, tell me and I'll extend it.
